Chachamaru and I were sitting on a heap of rubble.

A little while ago, this address was Fudaraku Castle's keep.
Now, not a trace. That was not our achievement. That was the enemy general's strength.

en.html:
Evening darkness covered the world.

Silver stars danced about like fireflies. But the one that should have shone brightest—where was it? Not among them.

The Forged Bomb had already been dropped. With it, the Silver Star had disappeared.

What had happened to Hikaru, I did not know.

ja.html:
夕闇が世界を覆っている。

　銀色の星が幾つも、蛍のように舞っていた。
　しかし、最も強い輝きを放つ筈の者はそこにいない。

　既に鍛造雷弾は落とされ、銀星号はそれと共に姿を
消している。

　光がどうなったのか、俺にはわからなかった。

en.html:
Just now I had said I would never believe her again.
So, aloud, I gave no answer.

Inside only, I nodded.

We let the time pass without speaking.
Catastrophe was taking place, and how peacefully the moment was passing.

Probably the world was going to end now.
But all around us, as though the ending had already happened... such quiet.

Not a sound. Only light and darkness moving.

ja.html:
二度と信じないと言った矢先だ。
　俺は何も答えなかった。

　胸の内でだけ、頷いておいた。

　黙って時を過ごす。
　破局という瞬間が穏やかに流れてゆく。

　世界はこれから終わるのだろう。
　しかし辺りは、既に終わりを迎えたかのように……
ただ静かであった。

　音はなく、光と闇だけが移ろっている。

en.html:
Chachamaru"Suno..."
Kageaki"…"
Chachamaru"One secret is still left, bhai. One I haven't told you."
Kageaki"Tell me."
Chachamaru"Haan. Actually..."
Chachamaru"It was love at first sight."
Kageaki"…"
Chachamaru"That first moment I heard your voice, from then only I liked you. ...Did you know?"
Kageaki"…"
Chachamaru"…"
Kageaki"Achha."
Chachamaru"Haan."
